items.evidence: LogView UserControl has x:Class='SDKTemplate.Logging.LogView' but project RootNamespace is 'AdaptiveStreaming'. App crashes at startup.
items.description: No guidance exists for migrating UserControls whose x:Class is in a namespace different from the project RootNamespace. In WinUI 3, this can cause XAML type resolution failures at runtime when the XamlTypeInfo generated code doesn't find the type.
items.fix: Add a section to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md about XAML UserControl namespace alignment and the typical startup crash it causes

items.evidence: The AdaptiveStreaming sample has Shared/Logging/LogView.xaml in SDKTemplate.Logging namespace; Controls/ContentSelector.xaml in SDKTemplate.Controls namespace. These must be discoverable by XamlTypeInfo at runtime.
items.description: UWP SDK samples commonly have a 'Shared' folder with UserControls (LogView, ContentSelector) and helper classes that all live in the 'SDKTemplate' or 'SDKTemplate.*' namespaces. The migration needs specific guidance on how to handle these: either keep in SDKTemplate namespace (valid) but ensure the XAML metadata generation covers them, or refactor to root namespace.
items.fix: Add guidance about ensuring all XAML UserControls in sub-namespaces are properly discoverable by the WinUI 3 XAML type system
